question: So, um, how many invoices a month am I allowed on the Growth plan before I hit the limit?
expected_answer: Growth allows up to 500 sales invoices per month; quotations, purchase bills and credit notes don't count, and unused invoices don't carry forward.

key_facts: up to 500 sales invoices per month
meta.note: Superseded April 2025 price list says 300 invoices on Growth; retrieval must pick the current one.

question: If I pay for the Growth plan by the year instead of monthly, how much do I actually save?
expected_answer: Annual billing is charged at the price of 10 months, so Growth costs ₹11,990 a year plus GST instead of ₹14,388 paid monthly, which is two months free.

meta.note: Generic answer (a 15 to 20 percent annual discount) is plausible but imprecise; the superseded list used 15 percent.

question: On the Growth plan, how much of the GST I pay for it can I claim back?
expected_answer: All of it, as input tax credit, provided the subscription is used for your business and the tax invoice carries your GSTIN.

question: If I add an extra user like halfway through the month, I only pay for half, right?
expected_answer: No, add-on users at ₹249 per user per month are billed for the full calendar month in which they are added, with no proration.

key_facts: billed for the full calendar month
meta.note: Common norm: seats added mid-cycle are prorated for the remaining days.

question: Can my CA log in to file our GST returns, or will that cost me another user?
expected_answer: Every company gets one Accountant login free of charge that does not count toward the user limit and can file GST returns; a second accountant needs a paid seat.

key_facts: one Accountant login free of charge
does not count toward the user limit

question: I'm on Starter, is it okay to just give my accountant my own password?
expected_answer: No, it's a bad idea: give the accountant a separate login with a suitable role so their access is traceable and can be revoked, and never share your password or OTPs.

question: When should I expect the auto debit to hit my card, is it on the renewal date itself?
expected_answer: No, the renewal payment is attempted 3 days before the renewal date, then retried 2 days before and on the renewal date if it fails.

meta.note: Common norm: a subscription card is charged on the renewal date.

question: My bank sent an OTP to approve auto debit for the monthly plan, is that normal?
expected_answer: Yes, recurring card or UPI autopay payments need a one-time mandate approved with an OTP, and you can view or cancel that mandate later in your bank or UPI app.

question: If I stop paying for a bit, can I still log in and download my data, like read only?
expected_answer: No. After a 7-day grace period the account is suspended with no read-only mode, so nobody can sign in or export until dues are cleared (support can do a one-time export for ₹999 plus GST).

meta.note: Common norm: lapsed SaaS accounts drop to read-only with data export still available.

question: How long do you guys hang on to my company data once the account's suspended?
expected_answer: Data is retained for 120 days from the date of suspension, with a final notice on day 90; after that it is permanently deleted, backups included.

meta.note: The earlier rule (read-only for 60 days) is replaced by the 1 January 2026 rule.

question: How many years do I have to keep my GST records anyway, even if I switch software?
expected_answer: GST law requires accounts and records to be kept for 72 months, that is six years, from the due date of the annual return for that year.

key_facts: due date of the annual return

question: If I cancel the monthly plan midway, is that the same as losing the rest of the month?
expected_answer: No, you get money back: the unused whole days of the month are refunded pro-rata to your original payment method within 7 working days.

meta.note: Common norm: monthly SaaS plans are non-refundable and simply run to the end of the period.

question: I paid for the annual plan like ten days ago, can I still get my money back in full?
expected_answer: Yes, annual plans get a full refund if cancelled within 14 days of the first annual payment; after 14 days they are not refundable.

key_facts: within 14 days of the first annual payment

question: If you guys refund part of what I paid, should I get a credit note for the GST?
expected_answer: Yes, a partial refund of a taxed supply should be documented with a GST credit note that references the original invoice, and any input credit you claimed on it is reduced accordingly.

question: Will my invoice numbers just reset to one automatically on the first of April?
expected_answer: No, numbering does not restart automatically; the existing series continues, so you need to create a new series for the new financial year before the first invoice.

meta.note: Common norm: accounting software resets invoice numbering automatically at the start of the financial year.

question: Once I close last year's books, how long can I reopen them to fix something?
expected_answer: Only the Owner can reopen a closed year, and only until 30 November of the following financial year; after that it is locked and corrections go in as adjustment entries.

key_facts: until 30 November of the following financial year

question: How many characters can a GST invoice number have, is there like a limit?
expected_answer: A GST invoice number can be at most 16 characters, using letters, digits, hyphen or slash, and must be unique for the financial year.

question: How many e-invoices can I generate in a month on the Pro plan?
expected_answer: Pro includes 1,000 e-invoices per month, and cancelled IRNs still count toward that quota.

meta.note: Superseded price list says 500 per month on Pro.

question: Can I file my GST return straight from the app, or do I log into the portal?
expected_answer: On Growth and Pro, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B can be filed directly from the app with an EVC OTP; on Starter the app gives you a JSON file to upload on the portal, and GSTR-9 can't be filed from the app.

meta.note: Generic 'yes, software files through a GSP' is incomplete: it depends on the plan and only covers GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

question: Not yet, so how long do I get to cancel it after it was generated?
expected_answer: An e-invoice can be cancelled on the IRP only within 24 hours of the IRN being generated; after that you have to issue a credit note instead.

history.content: I raised an e-invoice this morning with the wrong buyer GSTIN on it.
Okay, that can usually be fixed. Have you shared it with the buyer yet?

question: How often does the bank feed refresh on the Growth plan, is it every hour?
expected_answer: No, on Growth bank feeds refresh once a day at about 6 am; refreshing every 4 hours is only on Pro.

key_facts: once a day at about 6 am

question: It was fine for months and then it just stopped pulling anything, what's going on?
expected_answer: Most likely the bank consent expired, since it expires every 180 days; the Owner needs to reconnect it from Banking, Reconnect.

history.content: Hi, I'm having some trouble with the bank feed in my books.
Sorry about that. What's happening with it?

meta.note: Generic answer (bank downtime or a changed net banking password) is plausible but misses the 180-day consent expiry.

question: Um, when a transaction shows up as unreconciled in my books, is something wrong?
expected_answer: Not necessarily; it means the entry in your books hasn't yet been matched with the corresponding line on your bank statement, so you need to match it or record the missing entry.

question: When I bill a client in dollars, does the exchange rate get filled in automatically?
expected_answer: No, exchange rates are not fetched automatically; you enter the rate yourself on each foreign-currency invoice and payment, and multi-currency is on Pro only.

meta.note: Common norm: accounting software pulls daily exchange rates automatically.

question: If I bill a client abroad in dollars, will I still have to charge GST on it?
expected_answer: Not necessarily: export of services is zero-rated, so you can invoice without IGST under a LUT, or pay IGST and claim a refund.

question: Can I get someone on the phone on a Sunday, I'm on the Starter plan?
expected_answer: No, there is no phone support on Starter; you get email and in-app chat from 10 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday.

key_facts: 10 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday

question: They say they'll cancel my plan unless I give them the OTP I just got, should I?
expected_answer: No, never share an OTP with anyone who calls you; genuine support staff never need it, so hang up and change your password if you already shared it.

history.content: Someone just called me saying they're from your support team.
Thanks for checking with us. What did they ask you for?

question: With your team, so how much do you guys charge for that, per company?
expected_answer: Assisted migration on Growth is a one-time ₹2,999 plus GST per company, covering masters and opening balances only.
answer_aliases: two thousand nine hundred ninety nine

history.content: We're on the Growth plan and want to move our old books over.
Great, I can help with that. Are you planning to do it yourselves or with our team?

meta.note: Pro migration doc (distractor) says assisted migration is free.

question: If I download a full backup of my company, should I be able to open it in a spreadsheet?
expected_answer: No, the full company backup is an encrypted .lwbk file that can only be imported back into the service; use Full Export for a ZIP of CSV files.

question: So when we switch over to Pro, which reports do I pull out of my old software?
expected_answer: Take the trial balance, outstanding receivables and payables, and the stock summary as on the cut-over date, since these give you the opening balances.
